verdict.rationale: The first-party docs describe an authentication flow and search across more than 12,000 supported banks, but none of them mention bank-hosted OAuth, document OAuth coverage, or describe retiring legacy credential flows. The only reference to OAuth is a community comment saying Stripe proxies to Plaid-like providers for institutions without OAuth flows. That is not product documentation, and it actually suggests credential-based fallbacks remain. The 'without providing credentials' line applies only to Stripe-managed test institutions in testing mode.

support.subject: As a developer, connections to major institutions use bank-hosted OAuth rather than screen-scraped credentials — the platform documents its OAuth coverage and how legacy credential flows are being retired
